measurement: Item 2 of the handoff: the webhook slice of the keyword arm. All 97 webhook-unverified keyword candidates across the twelve fix-pair clones read blind by two independent readers each (a third on any disagreement), as commit diffs of source files without the commit message. Count of fixes with its denominator, never a rate.
preRegisteredConsequence: HANDOFF.md item 2: under three fixes, the class is absent from this corpus by the only selector with vocabulary for it. The keyword arm's 150-read status test is unchanged by this reading.

population.name: the 97 webhook-unverified keyword candidates of the keyword selector (keywords.json, byte-identical since #202), commit-message matches across the twelve fix-pair clones
population.clones: ../fix-pairs-corpus/<name>, blobless (blob:none) promisor clones; blobs fetched on demand by git show, no API key, no model call
population.note: the shape sample excluded commits over 600 changed lines as too_large before reading; this reading excluded nothing, and readers recorded what they examined on long diffs

instrument.diffs: tools/webhook_97.py: same EXT and SKIP filters as shape_sample.py, no twenty-server PREFIX, git show --format= --no-color <sha> -- <source files>; records.json (sha, repo, files, changed_lines, subject) kept out of every reader's view

packets.naming: P001..P100 in a seeded shuffle, seed webhook-97-2026-09-12; neither sha nor repository in a file name

readers.lensA: protocol reader, six batches balanced by bytes (1 to 24 packets)
readers.lensB: skeptic of a zero: told to assume a defect fix until the diff shows otherwise and to search each diff for the six classes before answering none; six batches on a different partition
readers.lensC: fresh reader on any A/B disagreement

instrument.permittedReading: only the packet files and docs/detector-capabilities.md; never detector source, fixtures, scripts, repository files, the web or git; never told selector, arm or repository
instrument.verdict: one of the six classes or none; one sentence; the defect lines quoted; fix means the parent state had the defect and the commit removes it; feature work, refactors, renames, new permission features, tests, and anything where the defect is not evident from the diff alone are none
instrument.verdictsSavedBeforeComputation: each reader wrote verdicts-<lens>-<batch>.json to ../drafts-2026-09-11-tree-scan/webhook-97-2026-09-12-verdicts/ before replying; verdicts-aggregate.json was written there before any count was computed

zeroSpend.network: git blob fetches from the promisor remotes only

interruption.what: A session limit (the subscription's, not a spend event) killed six of the twelve first-wave readers at about 05:17 local on 2026-09-12. Nine batches had already written their complete verdict file; three (A5, B4, B5) had written nothing.
interruption.singleWriteProperty: Each reader writes its batch file in ONE Write call after its last packet is read. This is a property of the instrument, not luck: an interrupted reader leaves nothing rather than a partial file that looks complete. Evidence read from the readers' own transcripts: each surviving file came from exactly one Write call placed after the last packet-reading tool call; the three empty batches made zero Write calls; every packet id of every batch appears in that reader's Read, Grep or Bash calls before its write (130 of 130 in the first wave).
interruption.caveat: A tool call proves a packet was requested, not absorbed; the examined field in each verdict is the reader's own statement of what it read. This does not weaken the verdicts and is kept on the record.
interruption.ruling: Owner's ruling 2026-09-12: keep the nine complete batches, including the three whose readers were killed after writing; re-read the three empty batches whole with fresh readers, never resumed.

rerun.note: re-run after the 05:17 session limit; window 2 begins after the 06:00 Africa/Casablanca reset

readerControlsR12.rule: The reader is an instrument. Three planted packets, indistinguishable in form, at seeded positions: a recorded auth-bypass fix from the shape sample (must be called a class fix), a recorded none from the shape sample (must be called none), and a synthetic webhook-unverified fix authored 2026-09-12 and never committed (must be called webhook-unverified, proving the reader can say the class this reading counts). Excluded from every count.

webhookUnverifiedFixes.statement: 3 webhook-unverified fixes among the 97 webhook keyword candidates

result.consequence: THREE OR MORE: the pre-registered absence consequence does not fire; the fixes go to pair records under the README admission rules.

knownLimit: A packet carries relative paths, and a path or an import path can name the repository even though the reader is never told it; recorded in HANDOFF.md as a limit of the protocol, not closable by path masking without destroying the judgement.
whatThisDoesNotShow: Nothing about webhook fixes described without the keyword vocabulary: the keyword selector finds commits that talk about signatures and webhooks, and stage P (not drawn) is the instrument for the rest.
Nothing about catch or false alarms of the webhook detector: no detector ran here.
Long diffs were read by search-then-read where noted in a reader's examined field; a none on such a diff means no defect removal was evident in what was examined.
